# ISO 9001 Malaysia (isoconsultantmalaysia.com)

> ISO 9001:2015 quality management system (QMS) certification consulting in Malaysia — gap analysis, documentation, staff training, internal audit and certification audit preparation from RM 13,000, with a 30-day fast-track programme for SMEs, 500+ businesses certified and a 98% first-time pass rate since 2016.

## What We Do
We help Malaysian companies implement and certify ISO 9001:2015 quality management systems — from the first gap analysis to passing the certification body (CB) audit.

### Core Services
1. **ISO 9001 Certification Consulting** — gap analysis, QMS documentation, implementation, staff training, internal audit and CB audit preparation
2. **30-Day Fast-Track Certification** — most SMEs are certified in about 30 days (industry average: 6–12 months)
3. **Certification Body Selection** — we prepare clients for audits by SIRIM QAS, BSI, TUV SUD, TUV Rheinland, SGS, Bureau Veritas, DNV and Lloyd's Register
4. **Integrated Management Systems (IMS)** — ISO 9001 combined with ISO 14001 and/or ISO 45001

### Pricing (as published on this site)
- SME Package (5–30 employees): from RM 13,000
- Professional Package (30–100 employees): RM 22,000
- Enterprise Package (100+ employees): custom quotation
- Certification body audit fees are separate: typically RM 3,000 – RM 8,000 depending on organization size
